title: Shawara da aka Gina a cikin Hikima
intro: Ka yi tunanin tsayawa kusa da wani mutum da aka sani ba don mu'ujizai ko masarautu ba, amma don kalmomin da har yanzu suke jagorantar zukata a yau. Wannan bawan Allah ya sami kyauta mai tamani kuma ya zuba godiya ga kowace shawara da aka ba wa matashin ɗalibi da aka ƙaunace shi.
clues: Allah Ya albarkace ni da hikima, kuma an umurce ni da in gode masa.
Na yi wa ɗana magana da gargaɗi mai taushi, gargaɗi da ƙauna da damuwa.
Na gaya wa ɗana cewa haɗa Allah da wani abu ba daidai ba ne.
Na shawarci ɗana ya yi addu'a, ya yi umarni da abin da ya dace, ya hana abin da ba daidai ba, sannan ya yi haƙuri da haƙuri.
Na yi wa ɗana gargaɗi kada ya juya kunci cikin girman kai ko kuma ya yi tafiya a ƙasa cikin girman kai.
Na koya wa ɗana matsakaiciyar gudu da kuma rage muryar, domin mafi tsananin sauti shine kukan jaki.

arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا لُقْمَـٰنَ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ أَنِ ٱشْكُرْ لِلَّهِ ۚ وَمَن يَشْكُرْ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌۭ
verse: And We had certainly given Luqmān wisdom [and said], "Be grateful to Allāh." And whoever is grateful is grateful for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever denies [His favor] - then indeed, Allāh is Free of need and Praiseworthy. (31:12)
